questions.stem: With `done` declared as a `boolean`, what does this page say `while (done = true)` does?

options.text: It is rejected by the compiler, which wants `==` there
options.says: The page says that with a boolean variable the line compiles.

options.text: It sets `done` on each check and keeps looping forever
options.says: The page says `while (done = true)` compiles and loops forever.

options.text: It runs its body once and then stops, as `done` is set
options.says: The page says the loop runs forever, because the assignment makes the condition true on every check.

origin.section: Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them

concepts: With a boolean variable, while (done = true) compiles and loops forever.
